start.summary: There is no budget yet. The AI prepares the first one from the project documentation; then you review and edit it.

start.title: Upload the project documentation
start.intro: One document is enough; with all four the AI measures more accurately. It reads them, adapts the project to the FRAMER Steel Frame system and builds the draft with the 20 chapters and the FRAMER 2026 price base.
start.failed: The AI could not finish the draft.

plans.title: Plans
plans.hint: Floor plans, elevations, sections, structure and services · PDF or photos

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.hint: Bill of quantities · PDF, Excel or BC3

start.time: It takes about 5 minutes. You can leave the page: the draft will appear here.
start.noMeasurements: Without measurements, the AI measures from the dimensioned plans: the measurements will be estimates and this will be explained in the “measurement criterion”.

read.title: It reads the project.
read.text: Data, floor areas, counts, measurements and inconsistencies between documents.

lines.title: It builds the line items
lines.text: of chapters 01–19 from the price base. Anything not in the base is marked as “estimated”.

contingency.title: It calculates the contingency
contingency.text: (chapter 20 = 5 % of 01–19) and applies the H0–H9 payment plan.

review.title: You review it.
review.text: The result is draft Rev.0, with a list of points to check before sending it.

start.privacy: The documents are also saved in the project's Documents, marked “team only”: the client does not see them.
